scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/data/*.test.ts tests/routing/*.test.ts tests/app/*.test.ts tests/ui/*.test.ts tests/render/picking.test.ts tests/render/quality.test.ts tests/render/tonemap.test.ts tests/render/wallField.test.ts
scripts.test:suites: node scripts/security-test.mjs --quick && node scripts/visual.mjs --quick && node scripts/perf.mjs --quick
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/security-test.mjs && node scripts/visual.mjs && node scripts/perf.mjs
scripts.app:dev: vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron electron/main.js
scripts.app:build: node --import tsx electron/check-endpoints.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node electron/package.mjs
